seller_feedback.feedback_text: Received item as described. For used GPU's they look to be in perfect shape. Very well packaged in electrostatic bags with plenty of bubble wrap. Seller was very accommodating when my first purchase attempt was on a card I did not mean to use for the purchase. Would definitely buy from this seller again! A++ Seller.

Delivered very quickly - 3 days US to EU by DHL. Professionally packaged in DIMM trays and hard box. Appears to be in good condition, as described. Shipping costs were good, but only after some negotiation before purchase: shipping was advertised as $1,000 per DIMM stick but corrected to $58 for all four. Why not show the correct shipping costs in the original advert?

Thank you for the efficient handling of my order; communication was clear and prompt, and the item arrived exactly as described and on time. The secure packaging and accurate documentation ensured everything arrived in good condition, and I also appreciate the availability of a return option.

Seller communicated well before purchase. A CPU pin was bent slightly, but I was able to fix it before installing CPUs. Had issues with UPS delivering incorrect packages to people in my area, but after I was able to actually receive my package, it was packaged well, and as described.
Prompt shipping. Item was brand new and sealed. Tested fine with 0 hours and 0 re-allocated sectors. OEM packing inside another box. Better than described. A+++ recommended seller.
Fast Shipping. Items as described and well packaged. Good communication. Great Seller.
Super fast shipping, well packaged, and exactly as described. Ran it thru a multiday stress test and it passed with flying colors! Highly recommended seller! Can't beat the value!

Excellent packaging as always, item arrived as described and in great condition. Recognized by my r730. Looks like it was taken care of during processing and not bounced around. Wrapped in ESD and plenty of bubble wrap.
